messages:
alex_cs: FYI EmberCare is hitting a big regional spike in eu-west1 this morning, looks like a marketing email surge. Customer asks for a short-term rate uplift + IP allowlist so their webhook retries stop being dropped. This is flagged as a renewal risk if user-visible failures continue. Can we coordinate a temporary regional fallback and a rate window?

maria_ops: Copy — can you paste the IP ranges and desired window? Also what's the expected qps increase so we can size the window properly?

alex_cs: IPs: 44.212.88.0/22 and 3.35.120.0/24. They want 2x qps for 6 hours starting 2026-03-21 16:00 UTC. If possible add eu->us fallback route for 2 hours after that window in case eu nodes still saturate.

sam_infra: Ok I can provision a temporary rate window and add a fallback route. Two quick asks: 1) Do we want to route only retries (5xx/429) to fallback or all traffic? 2) Confirm we should pin to model-v1 / low-latency pool or let routing pick cheaper variant.

june_eng: Recommend only route retries and 429s to fallback to avoid data residency surprises. For model pinning, leave it flexible but enforce same model family; set a hard TTL of 2h on the fallback so it auto-reverts. I can prepare a canary config now. Example routing snippet:```json
{"policy":"fallback-on-5xx-429","route_order":["eu-west1","us-east1"],"fallback_ttl":"2h","apply_to":"retries"}
```

emily_csm: +1 on retries-only. EmberCare legal confirmed the fallback to us-east1 is fine for retries during an incident but they want logs retained and a post-mortem note for renewal team. Can you also expose the per-route cost delta so CSM can pre-empt questions?

sam_infra: Will do. I'll spin up the temporary policy and add the IP allowlist. Plan: create allowlist entry, add rate-window (2x qps) for 6h starting at the requested time, create fallback routing for retries with 2h TTL post-window, and tag everything with embercare-account-id for auto-revoke.

alex_cs: Perfect. Please also add a short rollback automation to revoke allowlist at +30h in case manual revoke gets missed.

sam_infra: Adding auto-revoke at +30h, and manual revoke button in console. Creating infra ticket INF-5391 and will post progress here. ETA ~20m to apply rules.

(20 minutes later)
deploybot: deploy 2026-03-21T15:45:12Z infra/routing v2.3 applied by sam_infra — changeset id d4c3b2a.

sam_infra: Done — policy INF-5391 created and applied. Allowlist entries 44.212.88.0/22, 3.35.120.0/24 live. Rate window = 2x for 6h from 2026-03-21T16:00Z. Fallback route active for retries with TTL 2h (auto-revert at 2026-03-21T24:00Z). Tagged embercare-account-id.

emily_csm: Thanks — I've updated the renewal playbook with the post-mortem requirement and cost delta note. I'll message EmberCare to confirm and monitor.

(After initial monitoring)
maria_ops: Seeing a drop in 429s from their dashboard after the window started. No errors in the fallback route logs.

alex_cs: Great, I'll follow up with customer and log as "successfully mitigated transient surge" in CRM. Please keep the auto-revoke schedule.

sam_infra: Auto-revoke scheduled. Closing INF-5391 after post-mortem attachment. If anything changes ping me here. :thumbsup:
